get.summary:
Returns a page of the Content of the scope that matches the query, in their Metadata Provider's
order, with their texts in the signed-in User's language when it has them.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The words to look for, such as a title. A blank query matches nothing

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The Content Types to look for

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to return, from 1, the default: the previous page's `next_page`

AppSession.description: The session token a mobile app signed in with, and its User.

token.description: The token to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

AudioLanguage.description: The language a User wants to hear: the Content's original language, or a Track Language.

credits.description: Who made it and who's in it, in display order

media_group_count.description: The number of groups its Media are in, such as a TV Show's seasons

original_language.description: Its original language, as an ISO 639-1 code such as `fr`

original_title.description: Its title in its original language

rating.description: The average of its votes out of 10, to one decimal, or null when too few people voted

release_date.description: The day it came out, first aired or takes place

runtime_seconds.description: The runtime of its Media, when it has only one, such as a Movie

trailer_url.description: The YouTube URL of its trailer

Content.description: A Content as its page shows it, with its texts in one Locale.

ContentId.description:
The unique ID of a Content in WatchClub. Actions take it rather than an External ID, which a
Metadata Provider can change.

CreateInstanceAdministratorRequestError.description: The failures of a request to create the Instance Administrator.

Credentials.description: A username and password to sign in with.

Credit.description: A person or an organization who made a Content or is in it.

CreditKind.description: The part a person or an organization has in a Content.

CurrentUser.description:
The signed-in User, including what only this User can see: the Instance Administrator status
and the User Preferences.

allOf.description: The failures of a request to create the Instance Administrator.

message.description: The failure in English, for developers rather than users

ErrorBody_CreateInstanceAdministratorReq.description: The body of every error response: the error's `code` and details, and a message.

allOf.description: The failures of a request for a Content.

message.description: The failure in English, for developers rather than users

ErrorBody_GetContentRequestError.description: The body of every error response: the error's `code` and details, and a message.

allOf.description: The failures of a request to sign in.

message.description: The failure in English, for developers rather than users

ErrorBody_LoginRequestError.description: The body of every error response: the error's `code` and details, and a message.

ExternalContentId.description:
An External Content ID as the API sends it: the Content's type, and its External ID at the
Metadata Provider of its type, as text whatever the Metadata Provider.

external_id.description: The Content's ID at the Metadata Provider of its type, such as its TMDB ID

Genre.description: A kind of story a Movie or a TV Show tells.

GetContentRequestError.description: The failures of a request for a Content.

Image.description:
A picture in each size its Metadata Provider has, from the narrowest, so that the apps can
download the smallest one that stays sharp.

Instance.description: The information apps need about the WatchClub instance, which they read before signing in too.

mobile_sentry_dsn.description:
The Sentry DSN the mobile apps report their crashes and errors to, or null when they report
none

name.description: The Instance Name, which the host chooses

needs_setup.description: Whether Setup still has to create the Instance Administrator

sentry_environment.description: The environment the apps' Sentry reports name, as the server's do, such as `production`

web_sentry_dsn.description: The Sentry DSN the web app reports its errors to, or null when it reports none

LoginRequestError.description: The failures of a request to sign in.

Media.description: A Media of a Content, such as a TV Show Episode, with its texts in one Locale.

group_number.description: The group it's in, such as a TV Show Episode's season

number.description: Its number in its group, such as a TV Show Episode's

release_date.description: The day it came out or aired, which tells whether it's out

MediaId.description: The unique ID of a Media.

NewInstanceAdministrator.description: The Instance Administrator that Setup creates.

locale.description: The Locale of the visitor's browser

creators.description:
The people or organizations that make it, the most important first, such as a Book's authors
or a Sports Event's league, when its Metadata Provider says

date.description: The day it came out, first aired or takes place, when its Metadata Provider knows it

SearchResult.description:
A Content that matches a search, with its texts in the User's language when its Metadata
Provider has them.

SearchResults.description: A page of a search's results.

next_page.description: The number of the next page, or null on the last one

results.description: The results, in their Metadata Provider's order. Pages before the last can have none

SearchScope.description: The Content Types a search looks for, each at the Metadata Provider of its types.

TrackLanguage.description: A language a User can choose for audio and subtitles, as its ISO 639-1 code.

UserId.description: The unique ID of a User.

UserPreferences.description: A User's personal choices that shape their WatchClub experience.

audio_language.description: The User's default language for video playback

languages_without_subtitles.description: The audio languages in which the User watches videos without subtitles

locale.description: The User's language and country for WatchClub's interface

oneOf.description: The User's default subtitle language for video playback, or none for no subtitles
Characters other than lowercase letters, digits and underscores
